div.head: Wl art 8.2
div.ab: Et qui iuste venire deberent et venire noluerint, semel summo[n]eantur; et si secundo venire noluerint, accipiatur unus bos et summo[n]eantur tertio; et si non tertio venerint, accipiatur alius bos.

And those who are legally required to appear before them, and refuse to do so, shall be summoned once; and if they refuse to appear on the second summons, an ox shall be confiscated and they shall be summoned a third time; and if they do not come on the third summons, another ox shall be confiscated.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 240–241 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
